about.title: About.exe — Adam OS
about.name: Khoumari Adam
about.role: Embedded Systems Engineer · Builds with AI
about.p1: I build hardware that thinks and software that feels alive. I'm in my Master 1 in Embedded Systems at Bouira University (graduating 2027), and in 2025–2026 I led the Scientific Club Afaq as president, running hands-on workshops and robotics challenges.
about.p2: My weekends usually involve teaching robotics and Arduino to curious kids at CLS Bouira, configuring 24/7 home-lab Raspberry Pi AI agents, or tuning ESP32 motor drivers for miniature Rocket League soccer cars. If I'm not soldering a sensor array, I'm probably rewatching Spider-Man.
about.p3: I like clean code, tactile retro interfaces, and building real tools that solve actual problems. Have a look around — double-click anything.
